CustomField.description: Unique key that allows one open Request per link. Holds the Public Id, or E: plus the lower-case email address for a type-in Request. The batch clears it when the Request is processed or gives up retrying, so a new click can create a new Request. Case sensitive because 15-character record Ids in legacy links differ only by case.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set while the Request waits to be processed. Cleared when the Request is done.
CustomField.label: Pending Key
